title: Lash Photo Studio
summary: A one-page phone website for a lash or beauty artist. Snap a client's lashes, pick a look (soft studio, warm luxe, bright, moody), and OpenAI retouches the lighting and background into an Instagram-ready shot while keeping the lash work exactly as it is.
how_to_use: Give the folder to Claude and say: 'Deploy this to my Cloudflare account, set my OpenAI API key and an access code, and rebrand it for my business.' The README has the exact commands.
requires: A free Cloudflare account, an OpenAI API key with billing (separate from ChatGPT Plus, about US$0.15-0.25 per photo), Node.
